what: Over a dark ink curtain, the first color circle shrinks from full-screen size to a center circle (1.1s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1), after .25s). While it makes one turn (−360°→0, 1.6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)) it splits into top and bottom circles (1.3s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)), and the top circle sits on the bottom one with multiply so the overlap gets darker. The mark steps from the center to its left place (.9s) and the wordmark letters rise from .35em below at .06s intervals (.6s). After a 1s hold the logo group shrinks and flies to the nav logo spot (1s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)), the text color changes to the nav color, and the curtain lifts (.7s, after .25s). Click, key, wheel or touch lifts it in .25s and moves on

options.hold: Seconds the text stays after all letters have risen, default 1
options.speed: Multiplier applied to all times, default 1 — .5 makes it twice as fast
options.gate: Runs only when html has this class (attached early in head to hide the first screen). Removed when finished. When the curtain goes up ”<gate>Attach -built”
options.once: If session, only once per session
options.bots: if skip, it does not run for navigator.webdriver, bots, or pre-rendering (same as the original)
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: svg holding two circles (or the cell wrapping that svg) — circle fill via style="fill: var(--kf-…)" Applied directly to the circle (so the copy on the curtain follows too)

use: STUDIO
note: Curtain and text colors are --kf-contrast-bg and --kf-contrast-ink. To prevent a hero flash, add a gate class to html in head and html.<gate>:not(.<gate>-built) covers the first color with body::after (the original is an orange veil). The original skips it for bots·second visit in the same session·#hash addresses
